S002.name: Sustained_Attention_Difficulty
S002.description: Often has difficulty sustaining attention in tasks or play activities.
examples: Focuses at first during class or meetings but soon becomes distracted or spaces out.
Re-reads the same paragraph in a book multiple times but the content does not register.
Loses focus while watching movies or TV and misses the plot.
Unable to maintain attention until the end of a long meeting or lecture, often drifting off or becoming drowsy.

S008.name: Distractibility
S008.description: Often easily distracted by extraneous stimuli (for older adolescents and adults, may include unrelated thoughts).
examples: Easily distracted and stops working due to small noises or movements nearby.
Cannot concentrate because eyes keep wandering to the scenery outside the window or people passing by.
Starts daydreaming or gets sidetracked by sudden thoughts while working or studying.
Loses focus and listens in when hearing side conversations or TV sounds.

S009.name: Daily_Activities_Forgetfulness
S009.description: Often forgetful in daily activities (e.g., doing chores, running errands; for older adolescents and adults, returning calls, paying bills, keeping appointments).
examples: Forgets appointment times or meeting schedules, arriving late or missing them entirely.
Forgets to reply to received calls or messages for days.
Frequently incurs late fees because of missing deadlines for utility bills or credit card payments.
Forgets to take medication or leaves necessary items at home when going out.

S010.name: Fidgeting
S010.description: Often fidgets with or taps hands or feet or squirms in seat.
examples: Constantly shaking legs or twisting and squirming body while seated.
Spinning a pen or fiddling with nearby objects, unable to keep hands still.
Continually changing posture and feeling uncomfortable while sitting.
Constantly moving, such as tapping the desk with fingers or tapping feet on the floor.

S011.name: Leaving_Seat
S011.description: Often leaves seat in situations when remaining seated is expected.
examples: Frequently leaves seat or wanders around during class or meetings using excuses.
Unable to sit still during meals and keeps getting up.
Leaves seat in the middle of a movie or performance to go to the restroom or go outside.
Continually leaves seat and wanders around in the office where one is expected to sit and work.

S012.name: Feeling_Restless
S012.description: Often runs about or climbs in situations where it is inappropriate. (Note: In adolescents or adults, may be limited to feeling restless.)
examples: Feels uncomfortable and restless as if something is squirming inside when sitting still.
Feels internally anxious and stifled in situations requiring prolonged sitting.
A sense of urgency and anxiety that one must keep moving or doing something.
Feels unable to endure staying still and must constantly be doing something.

S013.name: Quiet_Activity_Difficulty
S013.description: Often unable to play or engage in leisure activities quietly.
examples: Unable to engage in calm activities for long, such as reading quietly or drawing.
Cannot play quietly, often shouting or making loud noises during games or play.
Unable to stay quiet in quiet places like libraries or movie theaters, making noise.
Cannot endure and avoids quiet and calm activities like meditation or yoga.

S015.name: Excessive_Talking
examples: Talks incessantly and cannot tolerate silence, continuing to chatter.
Continues to talk even when others are bored or try to cut the conversation short.
Talks too much inappropriately for the situation, making people around them uncomfortable.
Monopolizes the conversation and gives almost no chance for others to speak.

S018.name: Interrupting_Intruding
S018.description: Often interrupts or intrudes on others (e.g., butts into conversations, games, or activities).
examples: Butts into conversations of others where they have not been invited.
Joins in on others' work or games without permission or interferes.
Touches or uses other people's belongings or work without permission.
Keeps talking to and disturbing others when they are focusing on work or studying.

info.persona: Norman Meekin is a pragmatic yet easy‑going retiree who blends a love for organized community service with a spontaneous, competitive spirit at bridge tables, an occasional habit of over‑buying vintage records, and a tendency to forget routine health check‑ups, while they keep a light‑hearted approach to life.
info.professional_persona: Norman Meekin is a retired building maintenance foreman who channels their practical know‑how into running the community’s Fix‑It Friends volunteer repair service and orchestrating bridge and bingo nights, balancing a love of structure with a laid‑back, flexible planning style while they keep a competitive edge at the card table.
info.cultural_background: Norman is a second‑generation Irish‑American who grew up in the close‑knit, working‑class neighborhoods of Whitestone, Queens. Raised in a Catholic household, he attended a parochial school and celebrated traditional Irish holidays such as St. Patrick’s Day with his extended family. The cultural values of hard work, community loyalty, and modest hospitality shaped his outlook. While he embraced his Irish heritage—frequenting the local Irish pub, listening to folk music, and traveling to Ireland in his youth—he also absorbed the broader mosaic of Queens life, appreciating its diverse cuisines, sports fandom, and neighborhood camaraderie.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Norman thrives on sociable, group‑focused pastimes. He is a regular at the local senior center’s weekly bridge club and enjoys participating in friendly poker tournaments. He spends mornings walking the waterfront trails of Pelham Bay Park, often stopping to tend his plot in the community garden. Trivia nights at the neighborhood Irish pub and the annual Whitestone bocce tournament are highlights of his social calendar. When at home, he loves cooking large meals for gatherings, listening to classic Irish folk music, and collecting vintage vinyl records. He also follows the Yankees and Mets with a competitive edge, often betting on game outcomes with friends.
info.sports_persona: Norman Meekin stays fit by walking the waterfront trails of Pelham Bay Park, competes in the neighborhood bocce club’s annual tournament, and follows both the Yankees and Mets with a spirited betting habit, while they treat sports as both a social outlet and a friendly rivalry.
info.arts_persona: Norman Meekin nurtures a love for the arts through their extensive vintage vinyl collection of classic folk ballads and 70s rock, regular attendance at the local pub’s trivia nights featuring live acoustic sets, and occasional trips to the community theater for traditional plays, letting music and performance shape the way they socialize.
info.travel_persona: Norman Meekin’s travel style blends spontaneous road trips to Hudson Valley farms and New England seaside towns with a cherished pilgrimage back to the green hills of the west coast of Europe that inspired family stories, favoring flexible itineraries and discount fares while they always budget for a hearty home‑cooked meal on arrival.
info.culinary_persona: Norman Meekin delights in cooking hearty, family‑style dishes such as shepherd’s pie, slow‑cooked stew with potatoes, carrots, and cabbage, and a Sunday roast with rosemary‑infused gravy, drawing fresh vegetables from their community garden and while they serve generous portions to friends at every gathering.

info.persona: Marie Beck is a methodical 21‑year‑old factory technician who channels their solitary love of art and nature into sketching, upcycling, and a quiet ambition to climb the manufacturing ladder, all while keeping a stash of vintage postcards for creative sparks.
info.professional_persona: Marie Beck is a 21‑year‑old production line technician at a regional manufacturing plant, known for her methodical troubleshooting of machinery, meticulous inventory logging, and a clear ambition to earn forklift and CNC certifications and step into a shift‑supervisor role within three years, and they consistently apply their organized mindset to improve line efficiency.
info.cultural_background: Marie grew up in a middle‑class, predominantly white community in the Pacific Northwest, surrounded by the region’s appreciation for environmental stewardship and outdoor recreation. Her family’s cultural roots are a blend of generational American traditions with subtle influences from Scandinavian ancestry common in Washington state. This upbringing instilled values of individualism, self‑reliance, and a deep respect for nature. Living in Bellingham, she is also attuned to the city’s progressive, arts‑friendly atmosphere and an awareness of the local indigenous heritage, which informs her curiosity about diverse perspectives and unconventional ideas.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Marie enjoys solitary and reflective activities that feed her curiosity and love of art. She spends time sketching cityscapes and natural scenes, often accompanying her drawings with digital photography of the Pacific Northwest’s forests and coastline. Hiking the nearby Cascades and birdwatching provide quiet immersion in nature. She is an avid reader of contemporary fiction and philosophy, and she listens to podcasts on art history, technology, and unconventional thinking. On rainy days, she works on DIY upcycling projects, turning discarded materials into functional art pieces. She also keeps a personal journal where she records ideas, observations, and plans.
info.sports_persona: Marie Beck embraces outdoor fitness by solo hiking the Cascades with the Seattle Hiking Collective, joining birdwatching outings of the Pacific Northwest Birding Club, and cheering for the Seattle Sounders FC and Seattle Seahawks, yet they rarely attend gym classes, preferring the solitude of forest trails.
info.arts_persona: Marie Beck fuels their creative drive by sketching Cascadian cityscapes inspired by Ansel Adams, devouring contemporary novels by Sally Rooney, listening to indie folk from Sufjan Stevens and Fleet Foxes while tuning into 'The Partially Examined Life' philosophy podcast, and spending weekends upcycling discarded wood into functional art pieces.
info.travel_persona: Marie Beck prefers meticulously planned solo trips that blend wilderness immersion and cultural curiosity, having explored the Oregon Coast and Vancouver's art districts on a shoestring budget, while dreaming of hiking Patagonia's Torres del Paine and photographing Kyoto's bamboo groves when financial constraints ease.
info.culinary_persona: Marie Beck, an adept home cook, gravitates toward Pacific Northwest flavors—preparing cedar‑plank grilled salmon with a honey‑soy glaze, crafting kale‑pine‑nut salads topped with pomegranate seeds, and experimenting with fermented kimchi in repurposed mason jars from their upcycling hobby.

info.persona: Thomas Gebremedhin, a methodical yet compassionate leader, transforms corporate metrics into community impact while meditating through sleepless nights and finding solace in solitary cooking, gardening, and quiet contemplation.
info.professional_persona: Thomas Gebremedhin, a 38‑year‑old senior operations strategist, blends rigorous data‑driven planning with empathy‑focused leadership to drive sustainable growth, designing inclusive mentorship pipelines while meticulously overseeing financial performance and risk mitigation, and they channel their solitary, methodical nature into building a culture where profitability and social impact coexist.
info.cultural_background: Thomas is a Black American with Ethiopian roots, raised in Chicago’s vibrant multicultural neighborhoods. He grew up speaking Amharic at home while participating in the broader African‑American community, celebrating both Ethiopian holidays such as Enkutatash and American traditions. This dual heritage informs his values of communal responsibility, respect for education, and a strong work ethic. He maintains close ties to the local Ethiopian diaspora, attending cultural festivals and supporting immigrant‑focused initiatives, while also engaging with Chicago’s civil rights and social‑justice movements.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Thomas enjoys solitary pursuits that nourish his mind and spirit. He is an avid reader of history and philosophy, practices yoga and guided meditation to manage stress, tends to a small indoor herb garden, and explores Ethiopian and Southern culinary traditions through cooking. He also volunteers quietly at a local community center, offering financial literacy workshops to families in need.
info.sports_persona: Thomas Gebremedhin, a quiet fitness enthusiast, participates in early‑morning solo runs along the river trail, follows the NBA’s Denver Nuggets for inspiration, occasionally joins a local adult yoga studio, and they are a member of the community’s hiking club where they tackle weekend treks in the nearby mountains.
info.arts_persona: Thomas Gebremedhin, an aficionado of contemplative arts, spends evenings listening to the soulful blues of Robert Johnson, the ethereal Ethiopian jazz of Mulatu Astatke, and the introspective piano works of Ludovico Einaudi, while they attend occasional performances at the local theater featuring contemporary playwrights and collect vintage philosophy texts as decorative coffee‑table books.
info.travel_persona: Thomas Gebremedhin, an intentional traveler who prefers low‑key cultural immersion over crowded hotspots, has explored the ancient rock‑hewn churches of Lalibela, the historic streets of Kyoto, and the serene Scottish Highlands, and they dream of a solo retreat to the quiet vineyards of the Loire Valley, always planning trips months in advance to balance work commitments and family responsibilities.
info.culinary_persona: Thomas Gebremedhin, a proficient home cook, regularly prepares injera with berbere‑spiced doro wat and slow‑cooked Southern collard greens with smoked turkey, tends a thriving indoor basil and rosemary herb garden to garnish dishes, and they relish experimenting with okra and teff flour while pairing meals with Ethiopian tej and Southern bourbon‑based cocktails.
